findings.summary: Better-Auth route handler /api/auth/[...all] does not exist in either app; authClient POSTs 404 — sign-in/admin cannot work at runtime. AGENTS.md whitelists the route; nothing mounts it.

findings.summary: CI step-order bug: DATABASE_URL is exported at job level (and passed through turbo globalEnv), so the 'Unit tests' step executes the real-PG integration tests (jobs.test.ts) BEFORE the 'Migrate + seed' step — against an un-migrated database (beforeAll's DELETE FROM job fails with 'relation does not exist') → CI red on every run. Trigger bytes re-verified raw (od -c): `branches: [main]` is valid.
findings.evidence: ci.yml Unit tests (line ~55) precedes Migrate + seed (line ~61); job-level env DATABASE_URL (line 30); turbo.json globalEnv includes DATABASE_URL; jobs.test.ts:13 dbReady regex matches localhost
findings.confidence: Reasoned (deterministic trace; trigger corruption hypothesis retracted after raw-byte verification)

findings.summary: Checkout money integrity: PaymentIntent amount and webhook re-verification both compute totals with promotions:[] and shippingMinor:0 while the displayed cart total includes promotions — a discounted cart is charged undiscounted; order.discount always 0; §7.10 worked example unreproducible. Checkout address/email are Zod-validated then discarded; order_address rows are built from intent.metadata['shipping_*'] that is never written (all empty strings).
findings.evidence: checkout-service.ts:81 `computeCartTotals({ lines: priceLines, promotions: [], shippingMinor: 0 })` (twice); metadata only { cartId } at :90

findings.summary: Order transition trusts client-supplied `from` status; DB status never read; update has no status guard. A stale/replayed form can move an order sideways (e.g. DB shipped → client from=confirmed+start_production → in_production). §7.7 names transition() the only writer; §9.7 STRIDE Tampering requires server re-derivation.
findings.evidence: transitionSchema parses `from`; `const next = transition(from, event)`; tx.update(order).set({status: next}) unconditional

findings.summary: Rate limiting does not exist anywhere; rate_limit_hit table is dead (0 readers/writers); a comment falsely claims newsletter is 'rate-limited upstream'. PRD §9.4 mandates Postgres sliding-window limits (auth 5/min/IP+email, checkout 30/min/cart, typeahead 60/min/IP, newsletter 3/hour/IP, trade 5/day/IP).
findings.evidence: rg -i 'rate.?limit|rateLimit|rate_limit|Retry-After' in apps/+packages/ = 0 code hits; newsletter.ts:13 comment

findings.summary: Unknown job kinds do NOT dead-letter immediately under default maxAttempts=5: claim filter `handlers.has(kind) || attempts+1 >= maxAttempts` leaves them pending forever (attempts never increments). Header comment and PRD §4.8 say unknown kinds dead-letter immediately. Existing test masks it by constructing runner with maxAttempts:1.
findings.evidence: jobs.ts:86; jobs.test.ts:117 maxAttempts:1
findings.confidence: Reasoned (deterministic trace; needs PG to execute)

findings.summary: requirePermission throws a bare Error on insufficient role; called outside try/catch in both admin actions → framework error page instead of ActionResult {ok:false,error:{code:'FORBIDDEN'}}. FORBIDDEN exists in the §8.2 ErrorCode union but is never produced.
findings.evidence: admin-guard.ts `throw new Error('Forbidden: ...')`; orders.ts/products.ts call before try

findings.summary: Reservation protocol is not two-phase: placement decrements qty_on_hand directly; qty_reserved never incremented anywhere; no release on cancel / decrement-at-ship. Availability check + FOR UPDATE + made-to-order bypass ARE correct. Consequence: cancelled orders permanently lose stock.
findings.evidence: checkout-service.ts:288 `qtyOnHand: level.qtyOnHand - row.line.qty`; grep qtyReserved writes = 0
findings.confidence: Verified (code) — fix deferred to backlog (needs real-PG integration work)

findings.summary: AMOUNT_MISMATCH/aborted placement throws → 500 → Stripe retries forever; webhook_event row (inserted BEFORE the placement TX) persists, so retries no-op and the paid order is silently lost. §8.7 normative: create order in review + payment_orphan alert. Related: order-number sequence is MAX+1 (race → unique violation → same lost-order path); no per-year advisory lock.
findings.evidence: route.ts catch returns 500; checkout-service.ts:124-133 event insert outside placement TX; :203-204 MAX+1 sequence
findings.confidence: Reasoned (deterministic trace); advisory-lock part remediated this pass, §8.7 review-path deferred to backlog

findings.summary: Seed idempotency holes: announcement + nav_entry inserts have no unique natural key and no conflict target → duplicate rows on every re-seed; all other inserts key on real unique constraints. Local-host guard + advisory lock verified correct.
findings.evidence: announcement/nav_entry schema has no unique constraint; seed uses onConflictDoNothing only for some tables
findings.confidence: Verified (schema); live re-run not executed (no PG)
